site.audience: creative professionals, designers, illustrators, photographers, and hobbyists seeking online learning

brief.title: CreativeHub — Online courses for creative professionals
brief.one_liner: The largest creative learning community offering thousands of online courses taught by world-class professionals in design, illustration, photography, crafts, and more.
brief.goal: Drive course enrollments and subscription sign-ups by showcasing a vast catalog of creative courses, community projects, and membership benefits.

pages.objective: Serve as the main landing page showcasing featured specializations, best-selling courses, new courses, and platform benefits to drive sign-ups and enrollments.

Present the full course catalog organized by categories (Illustration, Craft, Marketing, Photography, Design, 3D, Architecture, Writing, Fashion, Web & App, Calligraphy, Music, Culinary, AI, Wellness) with filtering and browsing capabilities.
Showcase featured community projects in a masonry-style gallery with sorting and filtering by creative field, time period, and engagement metrics.
Promote the premium subscription plan by highlighting benefits including free course access, credits, certificates, and pricing options to convert visitors into subscribers.
Provide authentication options for existing users via social login (Facebook, Apple) or email/password credentials.
